invariants.rationale: A non-null engine context is typically required for distributed operations.
An instant time (commit time) string should not be null as it identifies the operation in Hudi.
The list of records to upsert should not be null; even if empty, the list is expected to be initialized.
The 'records' argument must be a List implementation; this is enforced by the method signature.
The instant time string should not be empty, as empty commit times are invalid in Hudi workflows.
